gloss: to melt; to dissolve; to thaw

definitions.explanation: to make a solid substance become liquid by heating or mixing with liquid

examples.japanese: {砂糖|さとう}を{水|みず}に{溶|と}かす。
{冷凍|れいとう}した{肉|にく}を{溶|と}かしてから{調理|ちょうり}する。
examples.english: Thaw the frozen meat before cooking.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
Intransitive pair: {溶|と}ける

USAGE:
- {熱|ねつ}で{溶|と}かす (to melt with heat)
- {水|みず}に{溶|と}かす (to dissolve in water)
- {溶|と}かして{混|ま}ぜる (to melt and mix)

COOKING:
- バター/{チョコレート|ちょこれーと}を{溶|と}かす (to melt butter/chocolate)
- {粉|こな}を{水|みず}で{溶|と}かす (to dissolve powder in water)

KANJI NOTE:
{溶|と}かす - for dissolving/melting (most common in cooking)
{融|と}かす - for melting metals or ice
{解|と}かす - for melting/thawing frozen items

RELATED:
- {溶|と}ける (to melt, to dissolve - intransitive)
- {溶解|ようかい} (dissolution)
- {融解|ゆうかい} (melting)
